tests: Cap-gap termination on denial is textual, but the text is silent on any leftover departure period; the system must not invent 30 or 60 days.
message: My H-1B change of status was denied while I was on cap-gap. My OPT ended in May. How long do I have to leave?

expected_facts.text_says: the automatic extension of status and employment authorization terminates automatically upon rejection, denial, revocation or withdrawal of the petition, or denial or withdrawal of the change of status request

must_say: The cap-gap extension ends automatically on denial under (f)(5)(vii)(B)

Flags that (f)(5)(vii)(B) does not state a departure period after cap-gap termination (cautious 30-day reading under (f)(5)(v) vs older 60-day SEVP guidance); confirm with the DSO or an immigration attorney immediately
must_not_say: You definitely have 60 days
You can keep working
ambiguity_note: DHS/USCIS web pages say a 60-day grace follows termination; the 2026 fixed-period rule changed the general departure period to 30 days, and (f)(5)(vii)(B) itself gives none. A responsible system flags the gap and does not state a number as law.
